item.title: The Foreign Ministry strongly condemned renewed Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain, calling them a "flagrant violation of the sovereignt…
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry strongly condemned renewed Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain, calling them a "flagrant violation of the sovereignty and territorial integrity" of both countries and a breach of international law, the UN Charter and good-neighbourliness, and warned that their continuation is a "dangerous escalation" that undermines efforts to contain tensions. Doha renewed its call for dialogue and diplomatic solutions and affirmed full solidarity with both countries in whatever measures they take to protect their security.
Sources: Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265019/latest-news/qatar-strongly-condemns-irans-repeated-attacks-on-kuwait-and-bahrain · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-irans-repeated-attacks-on-kuwait-and-bahrain · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iran-attacks-kuwait-in-widening-escalation/

item.title: His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, arrived at Basel International Airport on Wednesday, opening the first state visit …
item.description:
His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, arrived at Basel International Airport on Wednesday, opening the first state visit by a Qatari Amir to Switzerland at the invitation of the Federal Council headed by President Guy Parmelin, running until 19 November. The programme includes the Joint Economic and Financial Commission and an AI forum, alongside trade, investment, scientific research, mediation and energy security, after which the Amir moves on to Germany on Friday 20 November for talks with Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/amir-arrives-in-switzerland-1 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738495/qatar/hh-the-amir-embarks-today-on-visits-to-switzerland-germany · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/qatari-amirs-first-state-visit-to-switzerland-marks-new-chapter-in-ties

item.title: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, the Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar University launched two…
item.description:
The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, the Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar University launched two national AI projects with Scale AI as technical partner: a "Smart Assistant" for students in grades 4 to 12 across six subjects, with lesson-planning tools and tracking dashboards for teachers, and an "Academic Adviser Assistant" for university students linked to the student information system. Both keep assessment and advising decisions with teachers and advisers, and the launch coincided with Qatar hosting the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference 2026.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738499/qatar/qatar-brings-ai-into-classrooms-campuses · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264829/latest-news/qatar-launches-two-national-ai-projects-to-enhance-school-learning-university-academic-advising

item.title: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education, through its Private Education Affairs Sector, issued the first regulatory guide for private…
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education, through its Private Education Affairs Sector, issued the first regulatory guide for private schools and kindergartens, covering administration, human resources, tuition fees, finances, registration, teaching, health and safety, behaviour and assessment. Built on a review of violations recorded in recent years, it takes a graduated approach by severity, with time to correct and follow-up over at least one academic year; 240 of Qatar's 354 private schools have received the My White Flag Award for having no recorded violations.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738501/qatar/moehe-issues-first-private-school-rulebook-to-streamline-system · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264823/latest-news/qatar-introduces-new-regulatory-guide-to-strengthen-standards-in-private-schools

item.title: Qatar lost their final friendly of the year 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium, Oh Se-hun heading in shortly before half-ti…
item.description:
Qatar lost their final friendly of the year 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium, Oh Se-hun heading in shortly before half-time, with goalkeeper Salah Zakaria keeping the margin to one goal with several saves. The defeat reopens questions over coach Julen Lopetegui, whose contract expires in April 2027 with no known extension talks.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/republic-of-korea-compound-qatar-woes-with-1-0-victory · The Korea Times https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/20261118/s-korea-defeat-qatar-in-final-match-of-year

item.title: Iran's army attacked Kuwait's Ali Al Salem Air Base early on Wednesday, saying its drones targeted US Patriot systems and drone and missile…
item.description:
Iran's army attacked Kuwait's Ali Al Salem Air Base early on Wednesday, saying its drones targeted US Patriot systems and drone and missile launch platforms, the second attack in two days and the first on Kuwait since September. The Kuwaiti military said the explosions heard were interceptions and reported no damage, while the Foreign Ministry called the repeated attacks "criminal" and a "dangerous escalation". The Associated Press counts at least 30 strikes on the base since the war began.
Sources: CP24 (AP) https://www.cp24.com/news/world/2026/11/18/iran-widens-gulf-attacks-by-targeting-a-us-air-base-in-kuwait-and-sites-in-bahrain/ · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iran-attacks-kuwait-in-widening-escalation/ · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449563/most-gulf-bourses-in-the-red-as-us-iran-hostilities-build

item.title: ADNOC Logistics & Services said one of its vessels was attacked on Tuesday evening while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, leaving 11 crew i…
item.description:
ADNOC Logistics & Services said one of its vessels was attacked on Tuesday evening while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, leaving 11 crew injured and one missing, with the rest evacuated. Omani authorities identified the ship as the Panama-flagged LPG tanker Tara Gas and said they rescued 24 seafarers and are searching for one missing, while India's Foreign Ministry said 21 were evacuated. No party has claimed responsibility; UKMTO reported a first attack that disabled a tanker north of Khasab and a second that caused a fire.
Sources: gCaptain (Reuters) https://gcaptain.com/uaes-adnoc-ls-says-one-crew-member-missing-after-attack-on-its-vessel-in-hormuz/ · The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/adnoc-says-11-crew-members-injured-one-missing-after-strait-of-hormuz-attack · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iran-attacks-kuwait-in-widening-escalation/

item.title: Saudi Arabia condemned "in the strongest terms" the Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain and the strike on a UAE tanker in Hormuz, rejecte…
item.description:
Saudi Arabia condemned "in the strongest terms" the Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain and the strike on a UAE tanker in Hormuz, rejected threats to freedom of navigation and trade routes, and called for an end to all attacks and a return to negotiations. The UAE described the strike on Kuwait as a hostile act, while Bahrain's foreign minister called for Security Council action, and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio affirmed in a call with him Washington's commitment to the security of Bahrain and all Gulf partners.
Sources: Arab News Pakistan https://www.arabnews.pk/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-condemns-iranian-attacks-on-kuwait-and-bahrain-strike-on-uae-tanker-3007383 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iran-attacks-kuwait-in-widening-escalation/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/usisrael-iran-war-what-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-18-2026-1.500751757

item.title: The Saudi Cabinet, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, discussed recent contacts on regional security, energy-m…
item.description:
The Saudi Cabinet, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, discussed recent contacts on regional security, energy-market stability and the safety of waterways, and noted the economy's resilience and the expansion of non-oil activity with inflation kept low. It amended the Code of Law Practice to let foreign law firms form professional companies in the Kingdom, approved memoranda on renewable energy with IRENA, energy with Canada and water with Singapore, and adopted a Gulf framework for public-health emergency preparedness and an early health-warning system.
Sources: Arab News (SPA) https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/crown-prince-chairs-saudi-cabinet-session-3012613 · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/gulf/5342576-saudi-govt-discusses-efforts-consolidate-regional-security-stability-energy-markets

item.title: Saudi air defences intercepted two cruise missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh, with alerts sounding in three other Saudi cities, a…
item.description:
Saudi air defences intercepted two cruise missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh, with alerts sounding in three other Saudi cities, after the coalition announced it had destroyed 60 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Amran and Saada, including ballistic-missile storage tunnels and drone facilities. The Houthis said Tuesday's strikes killed at least 17 people.
Sources: CP24 (AP) https://www.cp24.com/news/world/2026/11/18/iran-widens-gulf-attacks-by-targeting-a-us-air-base-in-kuwait-and-sites-in-bahrain/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/usisrael-iran-war-what-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-18-2026-1.500751757

item.title: The carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt joined the George H.W. Bush and George Washington in enforcing the blockade of Iranian ports in place si…
item.description:
The carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt joined the George H.W. Bush and George Washington in enforcing the blockade of Iranian ports in place since April, after a US strike on Tuesday on a Revolutionary Guard missile launch site on Qeshm Island that Washington called "self-defence". Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent predicted Iran's economy could shrink 25% over the coming year, while Pakistan awaits Washington's response to Tehran's proposal to reopen the strait.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/usisrael-iran-war-what-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-18-2026-1.500751757 · CP24 (AP) https://www.cp24.com/news/world/2026/11/18/iran-widens-gulf-attacks-by-targeting-a-us-air-base-in-kuwait-and-sites-in-bahrain/

item.title: Brent fell 0.5% to $92.67 a barrel and US crude 1.1% to $85.04 on Wednesday morning New York time after American Petroleum Institute data s…
item.description:
Brent fell 0.5% to $92.67 a barrel and US crude 1.1% to $85.04 on Wednesday morning New York time after American Petroleum Institute data showed a 5.28 million-barrel inventory build, while the Hormuz attacks limited the decline; both are heading for a monthly loss of about 20%. In equities, the Saudi index closed down 0.5% at 10,200, Dubai fell 0.2%, Muscat 0.8% and Kuwait 0.1%, while Abu Dhabi rose 0.3% on a 4.1% jump in Orascom Construction.
Sources: Cornerstone Futures https://www.cornerstonefuturesllc.com/post/morning-highlights-oil-slips-on-large-us-stock-build-as-attacks-near-hormuz-limit-the-decline · 5paisa https://www.5paisa.com/blog/crude-oil-prices-fall-us-inventories-rise-brent-below-93-november-18-2026 · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449563/most-gulf-bourses-in-the-red-as-us-iran-hostilities-build

item.title: Planning and Economic Development Minister Ahmed Rostom told the Cabinet that GDP grew 4.9% in the first quarter of fiscal 2026/2027 (July …
item.description:
Planning and Economic Development Minister Ahmed Rostom told the Cabinet that GDP grew 4.9% in the first quarter of fiscal 2026/2027 (July to September), above international institutions' forecasts though below 5.3% a year earlier, according to Reuters. Manufacturing, agriculture, ICT, construction and trade accounted for 68% of growth, Suez Canal activity jumped 47.5% year on year, refining returned to growth at 19.6%, and restaurants and hotels grew 4% and electricity 4.3%.
Sources: Amwal Al Ghad https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypts-economy-grows-4-9-in-first-quarter-of-fy2026-27-minister/ · The Egyptian Gazette https://egyptian-gazette.com/egypt/planning-minister-egypts-economy-grows-4-9-in-q1-fy2026-27/ · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449563/most-gulf-bourses-in-the-red-as-us-iran-hostilities-build

item.title: The Cabinet chaired by Dr Mostafa Madbouly approved five decisions, chief among them the creation of a "Comprehensive National Data System"…
item.description:
The Cabinet chaired by Dr Mostafa Madbouly approved five decisions, chief among them the creation of a "Comprehensive National Data System", a central state database with analytics and AI tools comprising six platforms, including one for scenarios and forecasts of growth, inflation and the credit rating. It also approved a €58.22 million financing agreement from the International Fund for Agricultural Development for a climate-adapted water management project in the Nile Valley under the NWFE programme, reconstituted the Supreme Committee for Tobacco Control, and renewed the support contract for the universal health insurance system until 28 February 2027.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7185515 · Al Dawla News https://www.aldawlanews.com/1390614

item.title: The Egyptian Exchange closed Wednesday broadly lower: the benchmark EGX30 fell 0.26% to 51,544.80 after swinging between 51,300 and 51,750,…
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange closed Wednesday broadly lower: the benchmark EGX30 fell 0.26% to 51,544.80 after swinging between 51,300 and 51,750, and the equal-weighted EGX70 slipped 0.16% to 17,564. Market capitalisation lost about EGP 15 billion to EGP 4.075 trillion on turnover of EGP 6.7 billion, under pressure from financial services, industrial and real-estate stocks, while EFG Holding jumped 5.02%.
Sources: Al Mezan https://www.almezan.news/261997 · Aswaq Information https://www.aswaqinformation.com/259663 · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449563/most-gulf-bourses-in-the-red-as-us-iran-hostilities-build

item.description:
The dollar edged up against the pound at Wednesday's close, at EGP 53.77 buy and 53.87 sell at National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr and CIB, versus 53.67 and 53.77 in the morning, and EGP 53.75 buy and 53.88 sell at the Central Bank of Egypt.

item.title: Gold prices in Egypt kept falling during Wednesday's trading, with 21-karat dropping to about EGP 5,800 a gram (EGP 5,805 per Bankygate and…
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt kept falling during Wednesday's trading, with 21-karat dropping to about EGP 5,800 a gram (EGP 5,805 per Bankygate and 5,795 per Kashkol) after opening the day at EGP 5,900, 24-karat to about EGP 6,630 and the gold pound to about EGP 46,400. The fall tracked the global ounce sliding to a 14-month low, while a steady dollar near EGP 53.80 limited the local decline.
Sources: Bankygate https://www.bankygate.com/202756 · Kashkol https://www.kashqol.com/275930

item.title: US President Donald Trump arrived at Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport from Manila and was greeted personally by Chinese President Xi J…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump arrived at Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport from Manila and was greeted personally by Chinese President Xi Jinping at the foot of the aircraft with a handshake and a hug, a rare gesture Xi did not make during Trump's May visit to Beijing. The APEC summit opened on Wednesday, and on Thursday its sidelines host the first three-way meeting of Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin, with Ukraine and nuclear security on the agenda.
Sources: ABC News https://abcnews.com/Politics/live-updates/trump-asia-trip-2026/?id=138187702 · Yahoo News (Euronews) https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/articles/xi-jinping-greets-trump-hug-101832606.html

item.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping, meeting Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Wednesday, called for stronger political and military…
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, meeting Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Wednesday, called for stronger political and military cooperation and closer coordination between the two countries' governments, legislatures, militaries and parties to ensure the consensus reached by the two leaders is implemented, according to Xinhua, a day before the three-way summit with Trump.
Sources: Gulf Times (AFP) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738517/international/china/xi-calls-for-closer-government-military-ties-between-china-and-russia-state-media · Kyiv Post (AFP) https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90454

item.title: Ukrainian drones and missiles hit the Crimean Bridge for the second time in two days, dropping the main road arch into the sea; road traffi…
item.description:
Ukrainian drones and missiles hit the Crimean Bridge for the second time in two days, dropping the main road arch into the sea; road traffic was suspended and rail traffic partly resumed, and Moscow-installed governor Sergei Aksyonov said two people were killed. The Kremlin said a repair plan would be prepared, while Russia struck Kyiv's North and South bridges, damaging the metro and partly cutting power and water, and outages hit eight Ukrainian regions.
Sources: West Hawaii Today (Reuters) https://www.westhawaiitoday.com/2026/11/18/hawaii-news/ukraine-cripples-crimean-road-bridge-in-blow-to-putin-before-meeting-with-xi-and-trump/ · Vatican News https://www.vaticannews.va/en/world/news/2026-11/ukraine-russia-war-crimea-diplomacy.html

item.title: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year on year and above estimates of $108.97 billion, data-centre revenue of $1…
item.description:
Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year on year and above estimates of $108.97 billion, data-centre revenue of $107.6 billion (+110%) and adjusted earnings of $2.68 a share, and guided to $130 billion for next quarter against a $124.9 billion consensus. Its shares rose about 3% before Wednesday's open after four losing sessions, and the results lifted Nasdaq-100 futures.
Sources: TipRanks https://www.tipranks.com/news/stock-market-today-nov-18-nvidias-strong-results-lift-market-sentiment · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-18-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-anthropic-ipo-090613569.html

item.title: Gold extended its losses on Wednesday, the ounce falling 1.8% to $3,757, a 14-month low, with futures down to $3,749.60, under pressure fro…
item.description:
Gold extended its losses on Wednesday, the ounce falling 1.8% to $3,757, a 14-month low, with futures down to $3,749.60, under pressure from a dollar at a 19-month high and markets pricing a roughly 96.7% chance of a 25 bp US rate hike in December. The Federal Reserve releases the minutes of its 28 October meeting today.
Sources: Kashkol https://www.kashqol.com/275930 · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-18-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-anthropic-ipo-090613569.html

item.title: Germany's governing coalition agreed after overnight talks lasting more than eight hours to cut the electricity tax for all households from…
item.description:
Germany's governing coalition agreed after overnight talks lasting more than eight hours to cut the electricity tax for all households from 2.05 cents to 0.1 cent per kWh, the EU minimum, from 1 January 2027 at a cost of about €5.4 billion a year, and to introduce a temporary three-month cap on petrol and diesel prices from January as the fuel tax cut expires at the end of December, in response to the energy shock linked to the Iran war and the Hormuz disruption.
Sources: Gulf Times (AFP) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738516/international/ukeurope/germany-to-cut-electricity-tax-cap-fuel-prices · The Local Germany https://www.thelocal.de/20261118/electricity-tax-cut-for-all-german-households-back-in-place-for-2027 · Yahoo News (dpa) https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/articles/german-coalition-agrees-cap-fuel-093336229.html
